{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's leadership in life sciences R&D and medical innovation is being threatened.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the country does not work together now, the U.S. will lose its leadership position in medical innovation, U.S. job creation, and access to life-saving treatments for U.S. patients.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has led the global medical device and pharmaceutical industries for decades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. leadership in medical industries has brought millions of high-paying jobs to the country and life-saving devices and drugs to the nation's patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Lack of predictability, consistency, transparency and efficiency at the Food and Drug Administration is driving innovation overseas, benefiting foreign patients, not U.S. patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to reform the FDA to ensure the U.S. remains the world leader in medical innovation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure device and drug jobs stay in the U.S. through FDA reform.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure U.S. patients benefit first from new devices and drugs through FDA reform.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to prevent the FDA from wasting U.S. taxpayer and innovators' resources because of bureaucratic red tape and legal uncertainty through FDA reform.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
